scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands the origin branch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible solid and has a visible model browser
the Origin branch is expanded
the branch shows three origin planes, three origin axes and a center point
the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control
the origin children are hidden
the Origin branch remains visible
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user clicks the Origin branch expansion control again
the origin planes, axes and center point are visible again
the solid remains in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Select a solid feature in the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a single block created by an extrusion
the model browser shows the extrusion and its nested sketch
the user selects the extrusion row in the model browser
the extrusion row is highlighted
the visible block edges are highlighted in blue
a contextual toolbar appears over the model
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the blue edge highlighting and contextual toolbar disappear
the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands a feature branch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion with a nested sketch
the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser
the user clicks the extrusion branch expansion control
the sketch row is hidden and the extrusion row remains visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clicks the extrusion branch expansion control again
the sketch row appears beneath the extrusion
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the extrusion row context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a block created by an extrusion
the extrusion row is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion row
the row is highlighted and the block edges are highlighted in blue
the context menu offers Edit Sketch and Edit Feature
the context menu offers Show Dimensions, Measure and Properties
the context menu offers Expand All Children and collapses All Children
the user dismisses the menu and clicks empty viewport space
the context menu and blue edge highlighting disappear
the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Open and closes an additional browser pane

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part is visible in the MCAD Software
the Model browser tab is active
the user opens the add-pane menu in the browser header
the user chooses Favorites
a Favorites tab appears beside the Model tab and becomes active
the Favorites pane shows its content controls
the model remains visible in the same apparent view
the user selects the Model tab
the model hierarchy is visible again
the user selects Favorites and closes its tab
the Favorites tab disappears and the Model hierarchy is visible
the model remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Select an origin plane in the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the YZ origin plane is not visible in the viewport
the user selects the YZ Plane row
the row is highlighted
the plane appears as a translucent blue rectangle in the viewport
the block remains visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary plane highlight disappears
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Show and hide an origin plane from its browser menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the YZ origin plane is hidden and its browser row is visible
the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row
the context menu offers Visibility and New Sketch
Visibility is not checked
the user chooses Visibility and clicks empty viewport space
the plane remains visible as a translucent plane beside the block
the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row again
Visibility is checked
the user chooses Visibility again
the plane is hidden and the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore work features in the model browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software displays the single-block part fixture
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the Hide Work Features display preference is disabled
the user enables Hide Work Features in the browser display preferences
the Origin branch is absent from the model browser
the solid body and extrusion entries remain visible
the block remains visible in the same view
the user opens the browser display preferences
Hide Work Features is checked
the user disables Hide Work Features
the Origin branch returns to the model browser collapsed
the block remains visible in the same view

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the part root context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active saved part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block
the document root row is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the document root row
the root row is highlighted and the visible block edges are blue
the context menu offers file-location and file-path actions
the context menu offers drawing actions
the context menu offers Expand All Children, Collapse All Children and Find in Window
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes and the block edges remain highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the blue edge highlighting disappears and the block remains visible
